# Scene writing format

<!-- Generated by kition-sdk tools/writing-format.mjs from the Scene engine 0.1.0 and agent/guide.md. Regenerate it; do not edit it by hand. -->

What a model or a script writes to make or change a Scene document: the run syntax, every
command and its parameters, the value lists and the defaults the engine states, and worked examples.
It is made from the command catalogue of the Scene engine 0.1.0. Read
[`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md) first: it says how to address things, the workflow, and the
pitfalls.

## Syntax

Changes are steps of `scene_run`; each step is one command with its parameters as JSON:

```json
scene_run { "path": "<file>", "steps": [{ "command": "<command id>", "params": { … } }] }
```

A run is one step in the document's history. `scene_commands` finds commands by words; the
lists below are the whole catalogue. A parameter marked required must be given; a parameter left out
takes the engine's default (listed where the engine states one). Commands marked (reads) answer
without changing the document.

## Defaults

No schema states a default; the parameter descriptions name the defaults that exist.

## Commands

333 commands, by menu.

### Edit

- `edit.undo` (writes): Takes back the caller's last edit (the person's, or the agent's with `scope: "agent"`), leaving the other's edits in place.
  - `scope` string, one of `person` | `agent`, Whose steps to undo
- `edit.redo` (writes): Applies again the edit the caller's last undo took back, in the same scope as `edit.undo`.
  - `scope` string, one of `person` | `agent`, Whose steps to redo
- `edit.delete` (writes): Deletes `objects` (names or ids; the selection without it) from the scene.
  - `objects` integer or string or array, Object mode: the objects to delete; the selection when left out. Edit mode deletes the selected faces or vertices
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `edit.duplicate` (writes): Duplicates `objects` (the selection without it), moved by `offset`, and answers the copies' ids; a person's duplicate selects the copies, an agent's given `objects` leaves the selection as it was.
  - `objects` integer or string or array, In object mode, the objects to copy; the selected ones when left out
  - `offset` number[], Move the copies by this much, in metres [x, y, z]
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

### Edit > Select

- `select.all` (reads): Selects every object in object mode (or every element in edit mode); `action: "toggle"`/`"deselect"` changes that. Answers whether the selection changed.
  - `action` string, one of `select` | `deselect` | `invert`, What to do
- `select.none` (reads): Clears the selection. Answers whether it changed. No parameters.

### (no menu)

- `select.objects` (reads): Selects the objects in `objects` (names or ids), adding with `extend` or removing with `deselect`, for selection-based commands.
  - `deselect` boolean, Take them out of the selection
  - `extend` boolean, Add to the selection instead of replacing it
  - `objects` integer or string or array, required, The objects to select
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `object.order` (writes): Moves `object` to position `index` among its siblings in the outliner.
  - `index` integer, required, Its new place in the outliner, from 0
  - `object` integer or string, required, The object to move
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `mode.set` (reads): Sets object or edit mode for `object` (else the active object). Edit-mode mesh commands need `mode: "edit"` first.
  - `mode` string, required, one of `object` | `edit`, The mode
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh to edit; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `mesh.selectMode` (reads): Sets edit mode's element selection to vertices, edges or faces.
  - `mode` string, required, one of `vertex` | `edge` | `face`, What clicks select
- `mesh.select` (reads): Selects vertices and/or faces of the edited mesh by index (or all), adding with `extend` or removing with `deselect`.
  - `deselect` boolean, Take them out of the selection
  - `extend` boolean, Add to the selection instead of replacing it
  - `faces` integer[], Face indices (selects their vertices)
  - `vertices` integer[], Vertex indices
- `mesh.setGeometry` (writes): Replaces the mesh of `object` with `positions` and `faces` (vertex index lists), optionally smooth-shaded.
  - `faces` json[], required, Faces as lists of vertex indices, counter-clockwise seen from outside
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `positions` json[], required, Vertex positions as [x, y, z], in the object's own axes
  - `smooth` boolean, Smooth shading
- `modifier.set` (writes): Changes the settings of modifier `index` or `name` on `object`.
  - `angle` number, screw: degrees to turn
  - `angleLimit` number, bevel: edges sharper than this many degrees are bevelled; decimate planar: faces flatter than this join (5)
  - `axes` boolean[], mirror: [x, y, z] axes to mirror across
  - `axis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z`, screw and simpleDeform: the local axis
  - `constantOffset` number[], array: an extra offset in metres [x, y, z]
  - `coordinates` string, one of `local` | `global` | `uv`, displace: where the image is looked up (local: -1 to 1 in object axes covers it once)
  - `count` integer, array: the number of copies
  - `direction` string, one of `normal` | `x` | `y` | `z`, displace: where to push
  - `distance` number, weld: the distance that joins vertices
  - `enabled` boolean, Shown in the viewport and renders
  - `envelopes` boolean, armature: vertices in no bone's group follow the bones whose envelopes reach them (false)
  - `factor` number, smooth: how far each vertex moves towards its neighbours
  - `group` integer, geometryNodes: the node group's id (nodes.newGroup makes one)
  - `image` string, displace: an image's hash (from image.add) whose brightness pushes; null for none
  - `index` integer, The modifier's position in the stack, from 0
  - `inputs` object, geometryNodes: the group's inputs by name
  - `invertVertexGroup` boolean, armature: use one minus that group's weights
  - `iterations` integer, decimate unsubdivide: half steps of subdivision to undo, 0 to 16
  - `levels` integer, subdivision: levels, 0 to 6; multires: the level shown (at most the mesh's levels)
  - `limits` number[], simpleDeform: [low, high], the share of the range that deforms, 0 to 1
  - `merge` boolean, mirror and array: join vertices where copies meet
  - `mergeThreshold` number, mirror: the distance that joins vertices on the plane
  - `midLevel` number, displace: the value that does not move (0.5)
  - `mode` string, one of `twist` | `bend` | `taper` | `stretch` | `collapse` | `unsubdivide` | `planar`, simpleDeform: what it does; decimate: collapse, unsubdivide, or planar
  - `multiModifier` boolean, armature: deform what the Armature modifier above got and mix over its result by the group
  - `name` string, The modifier's name (instead of index)
  - `negative` boolean, shrinkwrap project: cast against it (false)
  - `noiseScale` number, displace: noise feature size in metres; 0 pushes every vertex alike
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh object; the active one when left out
  - `offset` number, solidify: -1 grows inwards, 1 outwards; wireframe: -1 to 1; shrinkwrap: metres kept from the surface
  - `operand` integer or string, boolean and shrinkwrap: the other mesh object; lattice: the lattice object; armature: the armature
  - `operation` string, one of `difference` | `union` | `intersect`, boolean: what to keep
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `positive` boolean, shrinkwrap project: cast along the vertex normal (true)
  - `preserveVolume` boolean, armature: blend the bones as dual quaternions, so joints keep their volume (false)
  - `ratio` number, decimate collapse: the share of triangles to keep, 0 to 1
  - `relativeOffset` number[], array: the offset between copies as a fraction of the mesh size [x, y, z]
  - `rename` string, A new name
  - `rim` boolean, solidify: close the open edges
  - `screwOffset` number, screw: how far along the axis one turn moves, metres
  - `sculptLevels` integer, multires: the level sculpt mode shows and sculpts
  - `segments` integer, bevel: segments across each bevel (1 is a flat chamfer)
  - `steps` integer, screw: steps around one turn
  - `strength` number, displace: how far, in metres, at full value; lattice: how much of the bend (1)
  - `thickness` number, solidify: the shell's thickness in metres
  - `vertexGroup` string, armature: a group whose weights say how much of the deformation each vertex takes; null for all
  - `vertexGroups` boolean, armature: vertices follow the bones of their groups (true)
  - `width` number, bevel: the bevel's width in metres
  - `wrapMethod` string, one of `nearestSurface` | `project` | `nearestVertex`, shrinkwrap: where vertices go
- `modifier.remove` (writes): Removes modifier `index` or `name` from `object`.
  - `index` integer, The modifier's position in the stack, from 0
  - `name` string, The modifier's name (instead of index)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `modifier.apply` (writes): Applies modifier `index` or `name` to `object`'s mesh and removes it.
  - `index` integer, The modifier's position in the stack, from 0
  - `name` string, The modifier's name (instead of index)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `modifier.move` (writes): Moves modifier `index` or `name` to position `to` in `object`'s stack.
  - `index` integer, The modifier's position in the stack, from 0
  - `name` string, The modifier's name (instead of index)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `to` integer, required, The new position, from 0
- `material.set` (writes): Changes material `material` (name or id): base color, metallic, roughness, emission, alpha, transmission and more.
  - `alphaCutoff` number, clip: the alpha below which the surface is not there (0.5)
  - `alphaMode` string, one of `opaque` | `clip` | `blend`, How the base colour's alpha is used
  - `baseColor` array or string, Base colour
  - `emission` array or string, Emission colour
  - `emissionStrength` number, Emission strength
  - `ior` number, Index of refraction (1.5)
  - `material` integer or string, required, The material's id or name
  - `metallic` number, 0 to 1
  - `name` string, A new name
  - `normalStrength` number, How strongly the normal map bends the surface (1)
  - `roughness` number, 0 to 1
  - `shader` integer or string or null, A shader group (id or name) giving the surface and volume in path-traced renders, or null to let go of it
  - `transmission` number, How much light passes through, 0 to 1 (glass at 1)
- `material.assign` (writes): Assigns material `material` to `objects` (names or ids; the selection without it).
  - `material` integer or string, required, The material's id or name
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `material.delete` (writes): Deletes material `material`; refused while objects use it unless `force`.
  - `force` boolean, Delete it even though objects use it; they are left without a material (false)
  - `material` integer or string, required, The material's id or name
- `light.set` (writes): Changes light `object` (else the selected light): kind, color, power, radius, spot size.
  - `color` array or string, Colour
  - `kind` string, one of `point` | `sun` | `spot` | `area`, The kind of light
  - `object` integer or string, The light; the active object when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `power` number, Watts (W/m² for a sun)
  - `radius` number, Soft shadow radius in metres
  - `spotSize` number, Spot cone angle in degrees
- `camera.set` (writes): Changes camera `object`: lens, clipping, sensor width (`sensor`), `sensorHeight` (1–200 mm), `sensorFit` (auto, horizontal, vertical), depth of field and aperture blades. Auto fits sensor width to the longer render dimension; Horizontal holds width; Vertical holds sensor height. Orthographic scale follows the same fitted dimension. Square render pixels only.
  - `bladeRotation` number, The blades' turn in degrees (0)
  - `blades` integer, The opening's blades: 0 for round (the default), 3 to 64 for a polygon
  - `clipEnd` number, Farthest distance drawn, metres
  - `clipStart` number, Nearest distance drawn, metres
  - `depthOfField` boolean, Blur what is out of focus in path-traced renders
  - `fStop` number, Aperture as an f-number (2.8); smaller blurs more
  - `focusDistance` number, Metres in front of the camera that are sharp (10)
  - `focusObject` integer or string or null, An object to keep in focus (an id or a name), or null for the distance
  - `lens` number, Focal length in millimetres
  - `object` integer or string, The camera; the active object when left out
  - `orthoScale` number, Span along the fitted frame dimension, metres
  - `orthographic` boolean, Orthographic instead of perspective
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `ratio` number, The opening's height over its width for anamorphic bokeh (1); above 1 narrows it
  - `sensor` number, Sensor width in millimetres, used by Auto and Horizontal
  - `sensorFit` string, one of `auto` | `horizontal` | `vertical`, Frame dimension held by the sensor or orthographic scale; Auto holds the longer dimension
  - `sensorHeight` number, Sensor height in millimetres, 1 to 200; used by Vertical
- `view.shading` (reads): Sets the viewport shading to wireframe, solid, material preview or rendered.
  - `mode` string, required, one of `wireframe` | `solid` | `material` | `rendered`, How surfaces are drawn
- `view.renderedStep` (reads): Advances the rendered viewport in bounded worker steps; a headless caller can wait for the completed preview. Sampling never changes the document or undo history.
  - `budgetMs` number, Worker time budget in milliseconds, clamped to 1 to 32 (8)
  - `denoise` boolean, Smooth the remaining noise away once the preview is done (false)
  - `maxSide` integer, The preview's longest side in pixels, 64 to 4096 (512, so a live view stays quick); the viewport's size at most
  - `samples` integer, Samples per preview pixel, 1 to 256 (32); changing this retains the compiled scene
  - `wait` boolean, Finish the preview before answering, for headless callers (false)
- `view.orbit` (reads): Orbits the viewport by `turn` and `tilt` degrees.
  - `tilt` number, Degrees up or down
  - `turn` number, Degrees about the up axis
- `view.pan` (reads): Pans the viewport by `right` and `up`.
  - `right` number, Fraction of the view's height
  - `up` number, Fraction of the view's height
- `view.zoom` (reads): Zooms the viewport by `factor` (above 1 zooms in).
  - `factor` number, required, Below 1 moves closer, above 1 farther
- `view.set` (reads): Sets the viewport's target, distance, turn, tilt and projection at once.
  - `distance` number, Metres from the target
  - `perspective` boolean, Perspective or orthographic
  - `target` number[], The point the view turns around [x, y, z]
  - `tilt` number, Degrees: 0 looks down, 90 level
  - `turn` number, Degrees about the up axis
- `view.resize` (reads): Sets the viewport size in pixels, which previews and the camera view use.
  - `height` integer, required, Pixels
  - `width` integer, required, Pixels
- `view.state` (reads): Answers the person's view state (viewport, shading, grid and overlays, selection, current frame, UV options), which the editor keeps with the host; never part of the file. No parameters.
- `view.restore` (reads): Puts back a view state `view.state` answered, leaving out objects the scene no longer has; a state of another version changes nothing. No edit.
  - `state` json, required, A view state view.state answered, in this session or another
- `material.setTexture` (writes): Sets an image (workspace `path` or base64) as a texture slot (base color, normal, roughness, …) of `material`, or clears it.
  - `base64` string, The image's bytes, instead of a path
  - `clear` boolean, Take the image out of the slot
  - `material` integer or string, required, The material's id or name
  - `name` string, The image's name, with base64 bytes
  - `path` file, A .png or .jpg file, relative to this scene's folder
  - `slot` string, one of `baseColor` | `metallicRoughness` | `normal`, The image slot (baseColor)
- `modifier.setImage` (writes): Sets the image a displace modifier reads (workspace path or base64), or clears it.
  - `base64` string, The image's bytes, instead of a path
  - `clear` boolean, Take the image off the modifier
  - `imageName` string, The image's name, with base64 bytes
  - `index` integer, The Displace modifier's position in the stack, from 0
  - `name` string, The Displace modifier's name (instead of index)
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `path` file, A .png or .jpg file, relative to this scene's folder
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `render.trace.step` (reads): Continues the path-traced render for `budgetMs` and answers its progress, with the picture so far when `preview`.
  - `budgetMs` number, About how long to render, in milliseconds (50)
  - `preview` boolean, Answer the picture so far as a PNG (false)
- `render.trace.image` (reads): Answers the path-traced picture so far as a base64 PNG. No parameters.
- `render.trace.cancel` (reads): Cancels the path-traced render under way. No parameters.
- `uv.preview` (reads): Answers a UV layout after a proposed `offset`, including live relaxation (`source` rejects a stale drag), without changing the scene, selection, history, or preferences.
  - `offset` number[], required, UV drag offset [u, v]
  - `source` string, Optional UV layout source token; reject a stale drag without changing the scene
- `uv.translate` (writes): Moves the selected UVs by `offset`.
  - `elements` object, Runs the command in this mesh's edit mode on these elements and puts the mode and the selections back afterwards, so no `mode.set` or `mesh.select` step is needed: `object` (the mesh, an id or a name), `vertices` and `faces` (indices from 0, as `mesh.select` takes them; every vertex when both are left out)
  - `offset` number[], required, How far in UV units [u, v]
  - `source` string, Optional UV layout source token; reject a stale drag without changing the scene
- `uv.rotate` (writes): Rotates the selected UVs by `angle` degrees about `pivot`.
  - `angle` number, required, Degrees, counter-clockwise
  - `elements` object, Runs the command in this mesh's edit mode on these elements and puts the mode and the selections back afterwards, so no `mode.set` or `mesh.select` step is needed: `object` (the mesh, an id or a name), `vertices` and `faces` (indices from 0, as `mesh.select` takes them; every vertex when both are left out)
  - `pivot` number[], The point in UV space to turn or scale about [u, v]; the moved coordinates' centre when left out
  - `source` string, Optional UV layout source token; reject a stale drag without changing the scene
- `uv.scale` (writes): Scales the selected UVs by `factor` about `pivot`.
  - `elements` object, Runs the command in this mesh's edit mode on these elements and puts the mode and the selections back afterwards, so no `mode.set` or `mesh.select` step is needed: `object` (the mesh, an id or a name), `vertices` and `faces` (indices from 0, as `mesh.select` takes them; every vertex when both are left out)
  - `factor` number or array, required, A number, or [u, v]
  - `pivot` number[], The point in UV space to turn or scale about [u, v]; the moved coordinates' centre when left out
  - `source` string, Optional UV layout source token; reject a stale drag without changing the scene
- `uv.layout` (reads): Answers the edited mesh's UV layout (faces and their UV coordinates), all faces or the selected ones.
  - `all` boolean, Every face, not only the selected ones (false)
- `file.render` (reads): Renders a preview of the scene as a PNG without changing anything: from `target.view` (`camera`, the scene's active camera; `front`, `back`, `left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom` or `persp`, framed to fit the scene or `objectId`) or `target.camera` (another camera, by id or name), at `target.time` (seconds from the first frame; 0 without it), in `target.pass` (`color`, `id` with a legend of object colours, `depth` or `wireframe`). `target.views` (2 to 6) draws one labelled sheet of views; `target.range` [from, to] with `target.frames` (2 to 12) one labelled sheet of times from one view. Without a target it answers four views (the camera or `persp`, then front, right and top). It never reads or moves the viewport, the current frame, the mode or the selection.
  - `maxSize` integer, The most pixels on the picture's longer side, 16 to 4096 (default 1024).
  - `scale` number, Picture pixels per render pixel (the scene's render size), above 0 and at most 2 (default 1). Each cell of a sheet is drawn at it. Reduced so the picture fits `maxSize`.
  - `target` object, What to show. One view (`view` or `camera`) at one `time`; a sheet of `views`; or a sheet over `range` from one view. Without a target, four views at the first frame.
- `frame.set` (reads): Goes to frame `frame` and answers it; the scene shows its animated state there.
  - `frame` number, required, The frame
- `driver.set` (writes): Changes a driver's expression or variables.
  - `bone` string, The bone of a bone property
  - `expression` string, scripted: Python-style arithmetic over the variables and `frame` (+ - * / // % **, comparisons, and, or, not, a if c else b, sin, cos, min, max, clamp, lerp, radians, ...); angles in radians
  - `index` integer, The component (x 0, y 1, z 2, alpha 3); every component when left out
  - `kind` string, one of `average` | `sum` | `min` | `max` | `scripted`, How the variables combine (scripted evaluates `expression`)
  - `object` integer or string, The object (or the armature of `bone`, the mesh of `shapeKey`, the owner of the material); the active object when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `property` string, required, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale` | `hidden` | `power` | `color` | `lens` | `baseColor` | `boneLocation` | `boneRotation` | `boneScale` | `shapeKey`, The driven property (bone ones name `bone`, shapeKey names `shapeKey`, baseColor is the object's material's)
  - `shapeKey` string, The shape key of a shapeKey property
  - `variables` object[], The variables, replacing any: { name, type: singleProperty, object, property, index, bone?, shapeKey? } | { name, type: transform, object, bone?, channel: locationX..scaleZ or scaleAverage, space: world, transform, or local } | { name, type: distance or rotationDifference, a, aBone?, b, bBone? }
- `keyingSet.remove` (writes): Removes keying set `name`.
  - `name` string, The keying set; the active one when left out
- `keyingSet.removePath` (writes): Removes path `index` from keying set `name`.
  - `index` integer, required, The path's position, from 0
  - `name` string, The keying set; the active one when left out
- `keyingSet.setActive` (writes): Makes keying set `name` the one `anim.insertKey` uses by default.
  - `name` string, location, rotation, scale, locRot, locScale, locRotScale, rotScale, available, wholeCharacter, or the name of one of the scene's own; null for none
- `action.remove` (writes): Deletes action `name` from the file; objects using it lose their animation.
  - `name` string, required, The action
- `action.rename` (writes): Renames action `name` to `to`.
  - `name` string, required, The action
  - `to` string, required, The new name
- `nla.removeTrack` (writes): Removes NLA track `track` from `object`.
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `track` integer, required, The track, from 0 at the bottom
- `nla.setTrack` (writes): Changes NLA track `track`: name, mute, solo, position.
  - `moveTo` integer, Moves it to this position, from 0 at the bottom
  - `muted` boolean, Does nothing
  - `name` string, Its name
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `solo` boolean, The only track evaluated (one at a time)
  - `track` integer, required, The track, from 0 at the bottom
- `nla.setStrip` (writes): Changes NLA strip `strip` of track `track`: action range, blending, repeats, scale; a meta uses `start` and `end` to move or stretch its children. Transitions follow their neighbors.
  - `actionEnd` number, The last action frame it plays
  - `actionStart` number, The first action frame it plays
  - `autoBlend` boolean, Blends in and out over the strips of the tracks below and above it that overlap it (switching it off clears the blends)
  - `blend` string, one of `replace` | `combine` | `add` | `subtract` | `multiply`, How it mixes onto the tracks below
  - `blendIn` number, Frames its influence rises over at its start
  - `blendOut` number, Frames its influence falls over at its end
  - `end` number, Meta strips: move or stretch the children together to this end frame
  - `extrapolation` string, one of `hold` | `holdForward` | `nothing`, Outside its frames: hold (both ways; only the first strip of a track holds backwards), holdForward, or nothing
  - `influence` number, A fixed influence from 0 to 1 in place of the blends; null for the blends
  - `muted` boolean, Does nothing
  - `name` string, The strip's name
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `repeat` number, How many times it plays (0.01 or more)
  - `reversed` boolean, Plays backwards
  - `scale` number, How many times slower it plays (0.0001 or more)
  - `start` number, The scene frame it starts at
  - `strip` integer, required, The strip on the track, from 0 (frame order)
  - `toTrack` integer, Moves it to this track
  - `track` integer, required, The track, from 0 at the bottom
- `nla.removeStrip` (writes): Removes NLA strip `strip` from track `track` of `object`.
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `strip` integer, required, The strip on the track, from 0 (frame order)
  - `track` integer, required, The track, from 0 at the bottom
- `nla.setAction` (writes): Sets how `object`'s active action blends over the NLA (blend mode, extrapolation, influence).
  - `blend` string, one of `replace` | `combine` | `add` | `subtract` | `multiply`, How the object's own keys mix onto the tracks
  - `extrapolation` string, one of `hold` | `holdForward` | `nothing`, Outside their keyed frames
  - `influence` number, Their influence, 0 to 1
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `graph.setModifier` (writes): Changes an F-curve modifier's settings.
  - `additive` boolean, generator, function: adds to the curve instead of replacing it
  - `after` string, one of `none` | `repeat` | `repeatOffset` | `mirror`, cycles: after the last key
  - `afterCount` integer, cycles: cycles after (0 forever)
  - `amplitude` number, function
  - `before` string, one of `none` | `repeat` | `repeatOffset` | `mirror`, cycles: before the first key
  - `beforeCount` integer, cycles: cycles before (0 forever)
  - `blend` string, one of `replace` | `add` | `subtract` | `multiply`, noise: how it mixes in
  - `coefficients` number[], generator: the coefficients
  - `depth` integer, noise: octaves beyond the first (0 to 32)
  - `end` number, stepped: steps only up to this frame; null for always
  - `function` string, one of `sin` | `cos` | `tan` | `sqrt` | `ln` | `sinc`, function: the function of amplitude · f(phaseMultiplier · frame + phaseOffset) + valueOffset
  - `index` integer, The component, from 0 (0)
  - `influence` number, Scales its effect, 0 to 1; null for full
  - `lacunarity` number, noise: frequency step between octaves
  - `max` number, envelope: the high end, above the reference
  - `maxX` number or null, limits: maximum evaluated frame; null disables
  - `maxY` number or null, limits: maximum curve value; null disables
  - `min` number, envelope: the low end, below the reference
  - `minX` number or null, limits: minimum evaluated frame; null disables
  - `minY` number or null, limits: minimum curve value; null disables
  - `mode` string, one of `expanded` | `factorized`, generator: expanded (c0 + c1·x + …) or factorized ((c0·x + c1)(c2·x + c3)…)
  - `modifier` integer, required, The modifier's place in the stack, from 0
  - `moveTo` integer, Moves it to this place in the stack
  - `muted` boolean, Does nothing (values of rotation channels are radians)
  - `offset` number, noise, stepped: frame offset
  - `path` string, The bone or shape key, for their properties
  - `phase` number, noise
  - `phaseMultiplier` number, function
  - `phaseOffset` number, function
  - `points` object[], envelope: control points { frame, min, max } in frame order
  - `property` string, required, The channel's property (location, boneRotation, shapeKey, ...)
  - `range` object, Limits it to { start, end, blendIn, blendOut } frames; null for everywhere
  - `reference` number, envelope: the reference value
  - `roughness` number, noise: amplitude step between octaves
  - `scale` number, noise: frames per noise feature
  - `start` number, stepped: steps only from this frame; null for always
  - `step` number, stepped: frames each step holds
  - `strength` number, noise
  - `target` integer, required, The channel's object (or material) id
  - `valueOffset` number, function
- `graph.removeModifier` (writes): Removes an F-curve modifier from a curve.
  - `index` integer, The component, from 0 (0)
  - `modifier` integer, required, The modifier's place in the stack, from 0
  - `path` string, The bone or shape key, for their properties
  - `property` string, required, The channel's property (location, boneRotation, shapeKey, ...)
  - `target` integer, required, The channel's object (or material) id
- `bone.set` (writes): Changes bone `bone`: name, head, tail, roll, parent, connection, deform.
  - `bone` string, The bone; the active one when left out
  - `connected` boolean, The head sits on the parent's tail
  - `deform` boolean, The bone deforms meshes
  - `envelopeDistance` number, Envelope: how far past the radii it fades out, metres (0.25)
  - `envelopeMultiply` boolean, Multiply the bone's vertex group weights by its envelope
  - `envelopeWeight` number, Envelope: its strength where full (1)
  - `head` number[], Where it starts, armature space [x, y, z]
  - `headRadius` number, Envelope: the radius at the head, metres (0.1)
  - `name` string, A new name
  - `object` integer or string, The armature; the active one when left out
  - `parent` string, The parent bone; an empty string clears it
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `roll` number, Turn about its own axis, degrees
  - `shape` integer or string, Custom shape: the object whose mesh draws the bone; null for the octahedron
  - `shapeBoneSize` boolean, Custom shape: scaled by the bone's length too (true)
  - `shapeRotation` number[], Custom shape: its turn in the bone's axes, degrees [x, y, z]
  - `shapeScale` number[], Custom shape: its scale [x, y, z]
  - `shapeTranslation` number[], Custom shape: its offset in the bone's axes, metres [x, y, z]
  - `shapeWire` boolean, Custom shape: drawn as its edges only
  - `tail` number[], Where it ends, armature space [x, y, z]
  - `tailRadius` number, Envelope: the radius at the tail, metres (0.05)
- `bone.select` (reads): Selects bones by name in edit or pose mode, adding with `extend` or removing with `deselect`.
  - `bones` string or array, required, The bones to select
  - `deselect` boolean, Take them out of the selection
  - `extend` boolean, Add to the selection
- `pose.set` (writes): Sets location, rotation and/or scale of pose bones `bones`.
  - `bones` string or array, The bones; the selected ones when left out
  - `location` number[], Location in the bone's rest space, metres [x, y, z]
  - `rotation` number[], Rotation in degrees, XYZ Euler, in the bone's rest space [x, y, z]
  - `scale` number[], Scale [x, y, z]
- `shapeKey.set` (writes): Sets shape key `name`'s value (0 to 1) or renames it.
  - `name` string, required, The key
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh object; the edited or active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `rename` string, A new name
  - `value` number, How much of the shape, usually 0 to 1
- `graph.moveKey` (writes): Moves a keyframe of an animated property from `frame` to `toFrame`.
  - `frame` number, required, The key's frame
  - `index` integer, The component, from 0 (0)
  - `path` string, The bone or shape key, for their properties
  - `property` string, required, The channel's property (location, boneRotation, shapeKey, ...)
  - `target` integer, required, The channel's object (or material) id
  - `toFrame` number, The key's new frame
  - `value` number, The key's new value (degrees for rotations)
- `graph.deleteKey` (writes): Deletes the keyframe at `frame` of an animated property.
  - `frame` number, required, The key's frame
  - `index` integer, The component, from 0 (0)
  - `path` string, The bone or shape key, for their properties
  - `property` string, required, The channel's property (location, boneRotation, shapeKey, ...)
  - `target` integer, required, The channel's object (or material) id
- `graph.setInterpolation` (writes): Sets the interpolation of the keyframe at `frame` of an animated property.
  - `frame` number, required, The key's frame
  - `index` integer, The component, from 0 (0)
  - `interpolation` string, required, one of `bezier` | `linear` | `constant`, How the curve runs to the next key
  - `path` string, The bone or shape key, for their properties
  - `property` string, required, The channel's property (location, boneRotation, shapeKey, ...)
  - `target` integer, required, The channel's object (or material) id
- `constraint.set` (writes): Changes the settings of constraint `index` or `name`.
  - `action` string, action: the action's name
  - `axes` boolean[], copyLocation and copyRotation: [x, y, z] axes copied
  - `axis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z` | `-x` | `-y` | `-z`, floor: the plane's side the owner stays on
  - `bone` string, A bone of the owner (an armature) to constrain instead of the object; the active bone in pose mode
  - `bulge` number, stretchTo and splineIk: how strongly the other axes thin as it stretches, 0 to 100 (1 keeps the volume)
  - `chain` integer, ik: bones in the chain counting this one, 0 runs to the root; splineIk: bones fitted to the curve (1)
  - `chainOffset` boolean, splineIk: keep the chain's root where it is
  - `channel` string, one of `locationX` | `locationY` | `locationZ` | `rotationX` | `rotationY` | `rotationZ` | `scaleX` | `scaleY` | `scaleZ`, action: the target's channel that picks the frame
  - `curveRadius` boolean, splineIk: the curve's radius scales the bones' thickness (true)
  - `enabled` boolean, On or off
  - `evenDivisions` boolean, splineIk: share the curve evenly between the bones
  - `extrapolate` boolean, transform: map values beyond the source range too
  - `frameEnd` number, action: the frame the channel's maximum plays
  - `frameStart` number, action: the frame the channel's minimum plays
  - `fromMax` number[], transform: the source range's high end [x, y, z]
  - `fromMin` number[], transform: the source range's low end (degrees for rotation) [x, y, z]
  - `index` integer, The constraint's position in the stack, from 0
  - `influence` number, How much of the result is used, 0 to 1 (1)
  - `invert` boolean[], copyLocation and copyRotation: [x, y, z] axes inverted
  - `iterations` integer, ik: solver iterations (500)
  - `keepAxis` string, one of `swingY` | `planeX` | `planeZ`, stretchTo: how Y turns to the target
  - `limit` boolean[], limitRotation: [x, y, z] angles limited
  - `mapFrom` string, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale`, transform: the target's channel read
  - `mapTo` string, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale`, transform: the owner's channel set
  - `mapping` string[], transform: for the owner's x, y, z, the target axis each reads
  - `max` array or number, limitRotation: highest angles, degrees [x, y, z]; action: the channel value that plays frameEnd
  - `min` array or number, limitRotation: lowest angles, degrees [x, y, z]; action: the channel value that plays frameStart (degrees for rotation)
  - `mix` string, one of `add` | `replace` | `before` | `after` | `multiply` | `beforeFull` | `beforeSplit` | `afterFull` | `afterSplit`, transform: add or replace (location), add, replace, before, or after (rotation), replace or multiply (scale); action: how the action combines with the owner
  - `name` string, The constraint's name (instead of index)
  - `object` integer or string, The owner; the active object when left out
  - `offset` number, copyLocation: true adds to the owner's location; floor: metres beyond the plane
  - `ownerSpace` string, one of `world` | `local` | `pose` | `localWithParent`, copyLocation, copyRotation, transform: the space the owner is read in (pose and localWithParent on bones)
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `pole` integer or string, ik: the pole target object
  - `poleAngle` number, ik: degrees the chain turns from the pole
  - `poleBone` string, ik: a bone of the pole target
  - `preserveVolume` boolean, armature: blend the bones as dual quaternions
  - `rename` string, A new name
  - `restLength` number, stretchTo: the distance, in the owner's Y units, at which it does not stretch; 0 takes the distance now
  - `space` string, one of `world` | `local` | `pose` | `localWithParent`, limitRotation: the space the angles are read in (pose and localWithParent on bones)
  - `target` integer or string, The target object
  - `targetBone` string, A bone of the target (an armature) to use instead of the object
  - `targetSpace` string, one of `world` | `local` | `pose` | `localWithParent`, copyLocation, copyRotation, transform, action: the space the target is read in
  - `targets` object[], armature: the bones that move the owner, as { object, bone, weight }
  - `toMax` number[], transform: the destination range's high end [x, y, z]
  - `toMin` number[], transform: the destination range's low end (degrees for rotation) [x, y, z]
  - `trackAxis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z` | `-x` | `-y` | `-z`, trackTo and dampedTrack: the axis pointed at the target
  - `upAxis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z`, trackTo: the axis kept up
  - `useRotation` boolean, floor: the plane turns with the target
  - `volume` string, one of `xzx` | `x` | `z` | `none`, stretchTo: the axes that thin
  - `xzScale` string, one of `none` | `boneOriginal` | `inversePreserve` | `volumePreserve`, splineIk: the bones' thickness
  - `yScale` string, one of `none` | `fitCurve` | `boneOriginal`, splineIk: the bones' lengths

- `paint.group` (reads): Sets the vertex group weight painting paints into, and answers it.
  - `name` string, required, The vertex group to paint (made on the first stroke)
- `paint.brush` (reads): Sets the weight paint brush (mode, weight, radius, strength, falloff, front faces only) and X mirror (`xMirror`, `topologyMirror`, `mirrorGroups`); answers them.
  - `falloff` string, one of `smooth` | `sphere` | `root` | `sharp` | `linear` | `constant`, How the brush fades to its edge
  - `frontFacesOnly` boolean, Only vertices facing the view
  - `mirrorGroups` boolean, X mirror paints in the group of the mirrored name, Arm.L and Arm.R (true)
  - `mode` string, one of `draw` | `add` | `subtract` | `blur`, What a stroke does
  - `radius` number, Radius in pixels (50)
  - `strength` number, How much one dab changes, 0 to 1 (1)
  - `topologyMirror` boolean, X mirror finds that vertex by the edges, for sides that differ in shape (false)
  - `weight` number, The weight painted, 0 to 1 (1)
  - `xMirror` boolean, Paint the vertex across X = 0 too (false)
- `paint.tool` (reads): Sets what the pointer does in weight paint: `tool` brush, linearGradient, radialGradient, or sampleWeight; answers it.
  - `tool` string, required, one of `brush` | `linearGradient` | `radialGradient` | `sampleWeight`, What the pointer does
- `paint.sample` (reads): Sets the brush weight to the paint group's weight at viewport pixel `at` (the nearest vertex of the face there); answers it.
  - `at` number[], required, Viewport pixels [x, y]
- `paint.gradient` (writes): Fills group `group` (the paint group without it) with a `kind` linear or radial gradient from viewport pixel `from` (full brush weight) to `to`, as one undo step.
  - `from` number[], required, Where the full weight is, viewport pixels [x, y]
  - `group` string, The group; the paint group when left out
  - `kind` string, one of `linear` | `radial`, Along the line, or around the start (linear)
  - `to` number[], required, Where it has faded out, viewport pixels [x, y]
- `paint.stroke` (writes): Paints weights into vertex group `group` along `points` with the current brush.
  - `group` string, The group to paint; the paint group when left out
  - `points` json[], required, The stroke's path in viewport pixels, as [x, y] pairs
- `paint.vertices` (writes): Sets, adds or subtracts `weight` on vertices of group `group` directly.
  - `group` string, The group; the paint group when left out
  - `mode` string, one of `draw` | `add` | `subtract`, How the weight is used (draw replaces)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the painted or active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `vertices` integer[], required, Vertex indices
  - `weight` number, The weight (1)
- `sculpt.brush` (reads): Sets the sculpt brush (kind, radius, strength, falloff, auto-smooth) and answers it.

  - `falloff` string, one of `smooth` | `sphere` | `root` | `sharp` | `linear` | `constant`, How the brush fades to its edge
  - `frontFacesOnly` boolean, Only vertices facing the view
  - `kind` string, one of `draw` | `clayStrips` | `smooth` | `grab` | `inflate` | `crease` | `flatten` | `pinch` | `snakeHook` | `mask` | `drawFaceSets`, The brush
  - `radius` number, Radius in viewport pixels (50)
  - `spacing` number, Distance between dabs as a share of the radius (0.1)
  - `strength` number, Strength at the centre, 0 to 1 (0.5; 1 for grab, snake hook, crease, mask, draw face sets)
  - `subtract` boolean, The other direction: in instead of out, unmask instead of mask
  - `symmetry` boolean[], Mirror dabs across the object's own [x, y, z] (x on)
  - `usePressure` boolean, Pen pressure scales the strength (true)
- `sculpt.stroke` (writes): Sculpts along `points` (or a `drag`) with a brush.
  - `autoSmooth` number, Smoothing after each dab, 0 to 1
  - `drag` number[], Grab and snake hook with world points: how far the last point drags, in metres [x, y, z]
  - `falloff` string, one of `smooth` | `sphere` | `root` | `sharp` | `linear` | `constant`, How the brush fades to its edge
  - `frontFacesOnly` boolean, Only vertices facing the view
  - `kind` string, one of `draw` | `clayStrips` | `smooth` | `grab` | `inflate` | `crease` | `flatten` | `pinch` | `snakeHook` | `mask` | `drawFaceSets`, The brush
  - `points` json[], required, The stroke's path: [x, y] viewport pixels, or [x, y, z] world points on the surface
  - `pressures` number[], Pen pressure at each point, 0 to 1
  - `radius` number, Radius in viewport pixels (50)
  - `spacing` number, Distance between dabs as a share of the radius (0.1)
  - `strength` number, Strength at the centre, 0 to 1 (0.5; 1 for grab, snake hook, crease, mask, draw face sets)
  - `subtract` boolean, The other direction: in instead of out, unmask instead of mask
  - `symmetry` boolean[], Mirror dabs across the object's own [x, y, z] (x on)
  - `usePressure` boolean, Pen pressure scales the strength (true)
  - `worldRadius` number, With world points: the radius in metres (0.25)
- `sculpt.tool` (reads): Selects a sculpt tool and answers it.
  - `tool` string, required, one of `brush` | `boxMask` | `lassoMask` | `boxHide` | `lassoHide` | `boxFaceSet` | `lassoFaceSet`, The brush, or a box or lasso tool that masks, hides, or makes a face set
- `sculpt.dyntopo` (writes): Turns dynamic topology on or off and sets its detail mode and size.

  - `percent` number, Brush: the longest edge as a percentage of the brush radius (25)
  - `refine` string, one of `subdivideCollapse` | `subdivide` | `collapse`, What a dab does to the edges under it
  - `resolution` number, Constant: edges per metre (12)
- `sculpt.gesture` (writes): Applies a box or lasso gesture (mask, hide, face set, trim) over screen `points`.
  - `action` string, required, one of `mask` | `unmask` | `hide` | `show` | `faceSet`, What happens to what the shape encloses

  - `outside` boolean, Work on what lies outside the shape instead
  - `points` json[], required, [x, y] viewport pixels: a box's two corners or a lasso's outline
  - `shape` string, one of `box` | `lasso`, A box (two corners) or a lasso (the outline)

Requires a Multires modifier, manifold quad topology with a boundary corner or extraordinary interior vertex per component (at most 100000 base faces and 250000 highest-level faces), linearly subdivided UVs, and no vertex groups, shape keys, masks, face sets, hidden faces, seams or UV pins. Unsupported inputs leave the document unchanged.

- `multires.rebuildSubdivisions` (writes): Recovers all complete quad subdivision levels, up to six, from a mesh with a Multires modifier and no existing levels. - `particles.set` (writes): Changes particle system `system`'s settings, including airborne boids with averaged Goal, Avoid, Separate and Flock rules. Targets use their current world-space positions; animated target history, collisions and force fields are unsupported.

Up to 2048 particles, 1000 emission-plus-lifetime frames and 500000 particle-frames and 500000 birth/death-aware particle updates. Faces or vertices only; scene force fields and collisions are inert. Targets use current world-space positions.
  - `bounce` number, The share of speed kept on a bounce, 0 to 1 (0.5)

  - `densityGroup` string, The vertex group whose weights set how densely particles and strands start (empty: everywhere alike)

  - `drag` number, Air drag: the share of speed lost per second

  - `emitFrom` string, one of `faces` | `verts` | `volume`, Where particles start
  - `frameEnd` number, Emitter: the last frame particles are born (200)
  - `frameStart` number, Emitter: the first frame particles are born (1)
  - `gravity` number, How strongly the scene's gravity pulls (1)
  - `hairLength` number, Hair: strand length, metres (4)
  - `instanceObject` integer or string, With renderAs object: the object copied at each particle (null for none)
  - `kind` string, one of `emitter` | `hair`, Emitter (particles that fly) or hair (strands)
  - `lifetime` number, Emitter: frames a particle lives (50)
  - `lifetimeRandom` number, Emitter: how much of the lifetime may randomly be cut, 0 to 1
  - `name` string, A new name for the system
  - `normalVelocity` number, Start speed along the surface normal, m/s (1)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the active one when left out
  - `objectVelocity` number[], Start velocity along the emitter's axes, m/s [x, y, z]
  - `physics` string, one of `newtonian` | `boids`, Emitter physics: Newtonian or airborne boids with averaged rules
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `randomVelocity` number, Start speed in a random direction, m/s
  - `renderAs` string, one of `halo` | `object` | `none`, How particles show
  - `rotationRandom` number, How far instances turn at random, 0 to 1
  - `seed` integer, Different seeds give different, each repeatable, particles (0)
  - `segments` integer, Hair: segments per strand (5)
  - `size` number, Particle size (halo diameter, instance scale), metres (0.05)
  - `sizeRandom` number, How much of the size may randomly be taken off, 0 to 1
  - `strandWidth` number, Hair: strand width at the root, metres (0.01)
  - `system` integer or string, The system's index or name; the first when left out
  - `timestep` number, Seconds simulated per frame (0.04)
