  - `keyingSet` string, insertKey: key what this keying set names instead (the active one is used when no properties are given)
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `properties` string[], What to key: location, rotation, scale, hidden; power and color of a light; lens of a camera; baseColor of the object's material (location, rotation, and scale when left out)
- `anim.deleteKey` (writes): Deletes the keyframes for `properties` of `objects` (names or ids; the selection without it) at `frame`.
  - `frame` number, The frame; the current frame when left out
  - `keyingSet` string, insertKey: key what this keying set names instead (the active one is used when no properties are given)
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `properties` string[], What to key: location, rotation, scale, hidden; power and color of a light; lens of a camera; baseColor of the object's material (location, rotation, and scale when left out)
- `anim.clear` (writes): Clears every keyframe (or those of `properties`) of `objects` (names or ids; the selection without it).
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `properties` string[], Only these properties (every animated one when left out)
- `anim.setInterpolation` (writes): Sets the interpolation (constant, linear, bezier, …) of keyframes of `objects` (names or ids; the selection without it) at `frame`.
  - `frame` number, Only the keys on this frame (every key when left out)
  - `interpolation` string, required, one of `bezier` | `linear` | `constant`, How the curve runs from a key to the next
  - `keyingSet` string, insertKey: key what this keying set names instead (the active one is used when no properties are given)
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `properties` string[], What to key: location, rotation, scale, hidden; power and color of a light; lens of a camera; baseColor of the object's material (location, rotation, and scale when left out)

### View > Frame

- `frame.next` (reads): Goes to the next frame and answers it. No parameters.
- `frame.previous` (reads): Goes to the previous frame (wrapping to the end) and answers it. No parameters.
- `frame.start` (reads): Goes to the first frame of the range and answers it. No parameters.
- `frame.end` (reads): Goes to the last frame of the range and answers it. No parameters.
- `anim.nextKey` (reads): Goes to the next keyframe of the selected objects and answers its frame. No parameters.
- `anim.previousKey` (reads): Goes to the previous keyframe of the selected objects and answers its frame. No parameters.

### Object > Animation > Drivers

- `driver.add` (writes): Adds a driver to a property (of an object, bone or shape key) computed from `expression` and its variables.
  - `bone` string, The bone of a bone property
  - `expression` string, scripted: Python-style arithmetic over the variables and `frame` (+ - * / // % **, comparisons, and, or, not, a if c else b, sin, cos, min, max, clamp, lerp, radians, ...); angles in radians
  - `index` integer, The component (x 0, y 1, z 2, alpha 3); every component when left out
  - `kind` string, one of `average` | `sum` | `min` | `max` | `scripted`, How the variables combine (scripted evaluates `expression`)
  - `object` integer or string, The object (or the armature of `bone`, the mesh of `shapeKey`, the owner of the material); the active object when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `property` string, required, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale` | `hidden` | `power` | `color` | `lens` | `baseColor` | `boneLocation` | `boneRotation` | `boneScale` | `shapeKey`, The driven property (bone ones name `bone`, shapeKey names `shapeKey`, baseColor is the object's material's)
  - `shapeKey` string, The shape key of a shapeKey property
  - `variables` object[], The variables, replacing any: { name, type: singleProperty, object, property, index, bone?, shapeKey? } | { name, type: transform, object, bone?, channel: locationX..scaleZ or scaleAverage, space: world, transform, or local } | { name, type: distance or rotationDifference, a, aBone?, b, bBone? }
- `driver.remove` (writes): Removes the driver from a property.
  - `bone` string, The bone of a bone property
  - `index` integer, The component (x 0, y 1, z 2, alpha 3); every component when left out
  - `object` integer or string, The object (or the armature of `bone`, the mesh of `shapeKey`, the owner of the material); the active object when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `property` string, required, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale` | `hidden` | `power` | `color` | `lens` | `baseColor` | `boneLocation` | `boneRotation` | `boneScale` | `shapeKey`, The driven property (bone ones name `bone`, shapeKey names `shapeKey`, baseColor is the object's material's)
  - `shapeKey` string, The shape key of a shapeKey property

### Object > Animation > Keying Sets

- `keyingSet.new` (writes): Adds a keying set named `name` to the scene.

- `keyingSet.addPaths` (writes): Adds properties of objects or bones to keying set `name`.

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `properties` string[], The properties (location, rotation, and scale when left out; bone ones with `bones`)

### Object > Animation > Actions

- `action.new` (writes): Creates an action named `name` and assigns it to `object`.

  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

- `nla.addTransition` (writes): Adds a transition between strip `strip` and its next neighbor on track `track`, blending their endpoint evaluations across the gap.
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

- `nla.makeMeta` (writes): Groups the contiguous strips `first` through `last` on `track` into one meta strip; its start and end move or stretch the children together.
  - `first` integer, required, First strip in the contiguous group
  - `last` integer, required, Last strip in the contiguous group, inclusive
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `track` integer, required, The track, from 0 at the bottom
- `nla.dissolveMeta` (writes): Ungroups meta strip `strip` on `track`, preserving the children's current timing and blending.
  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `strip` integer, required, The strip on the track, from 0 (frame order)
  - `track` integer, required, The track, from 0 at the bottom

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

  - `object` integer or string, The object; the active one when left out

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

### Object > Animation > F-Curve Modifiers

- `graph.addModifier` (writes): Adds an F-curve modifier (cycles, noise, generator, …) to an animated property's curve.
  - `additive` boolean, generator, function: adds to the curve instead of replacing it
  - `after` string, one of `none` | `repeat` | `repeatOffset` | `mirror`, cycles: after the last key
  - `afterCount` integer, cycles: cycles after (0 forever)
  - `amplitude` number, function
  - `before` string, one of `none` | `repeat` | `repeatOffset` | `mirror`, cycles: before the first key
  - `beforeCount` integer, cycles: cycles before (0 forever)
  - `blend` string, one of `replace` | `add` | `subtract` | `multiply`, noise: how it mixes in
  - `coefficients` number[], generator: the coefficients
  - `depth` integer, noise: octaves beyond the first (0 to 32)
  - `end` number, stepped: steps only up to this frame; null for always
  - `function` string, one of `sin` | `cos` | `tan` | `sqrt` | `ln` | `sinc`, function: the function of amplitude · f(phaseMultiplier · frame + phaseOffset) + valueOffset
  - `index` integer, The component, from 0 (0)
  - `influence` number, Scales its effect, 0 to 1; null for full
  - `lacunarity` number, noise: frequency step between octaves
  - `max` number, envelope: the high end, above the reference
  - `maxX` number or null, limits: maximum evaluated frame; null disables
  - `maxY` number or null, limits: maximum curve value; null disables
  - `min` number, envelope: the low end, below the reference
  - `minX` number or null, limits: minimum evaluated frame; null disables
  - `minY` number or null, limits: minimum curve value; null disables
  - `mode` string, one of `expanded` | `factorized`, generator: expanded (c0 + c1·x + …) or factorized ((c0·x + c1)(c2·x + c3)…)
  - `muted` boolean, Does nothing (values of rotation channels are radians)
  - `offset` number, noise, stepped: frame offset
  - `path` string, The bone or shape key, for their properties
  - `phase` number, noise
  - `phaseMultiplier` number, function
  - `phaseOffset` number, function
  - `points` object[], envelope: control points { frame, min, max } in frame order
  - `property` string, required, The channel's property (location, boneRotation, shapeKey, ...)
  - `range` object, Limits it to { start, end, blendIn, blendOut } frames; null for everywhere
  - `reference` number, envelope: the reference value
  - `roughness` number, noise: amplitude step between octaves
  - `scale` number, noise: frames per noise feature
  - `start` number, stepped: steps only from this frame; null for always
  - `step` number, stepped: frames each step holds
  - `strength` number, noise
  - `target` integer, required, The channel's object (or material) id
  - `type` string, required, one of `generator` | `function` | `envelope` | `cycles` | `noise` | `stepped` | `limits`, The modifier
  - `valueOffset` number, function

### Armature

- `mode.armature` (reads): Toggles the armature `object` (the active one without it) between object mode and bone edit mode.
  - `object` integer or string, The armature; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `mode.pose` (reads): Turns pose mode on or off for armature `object`.
  - `object` integer or string, The armature; the active one when left out
  - `on` boolean, Pose mode on or off; toggles when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
- `bone.add` (writes): Adds a bone with head and tail to the armature in edit mode, optionally parented and connected.
  - `connected` boolean, The head sits on the parent's tail
  - `head` number[], Where it starts, in the armature's space (the origin) [x, y, z]
  - `name` string, The bone's name (Bone)
  - `parent` string, The parent bone
  - `tail` number[], Where it ends (a metre above the head) [x, y, z]
- `bone.extrude` (writes): Extrudes a new bone from the selected bone's tail by `length` or to `tail`.
  - `length` number, Its length along the bone it grows from (the same length)
  - `tail` number[], Where the new bone ends, in the armature's space [x, y, z]

### Pose

- `pose.clear` (writes): Clears the pose of `bones` (or all) back to the rest pose.
  - `all` boolean, Every bone
  - `bones` string or array, The bones; the selected ones when left out
- `pose.insertKey` (writes): Inserts keyframes for pose bones `bones` at `frame`.
  - `bones` string or array, The bones; the selected ones when left out
  - `frame` number, The frame; the current frame when left out
  - `keyingSet` string, Key what this keying set names instead (the active one is used when no properties are given)
  - `properties` string[], What to key (all three when left out)
- `pose.deleteKey` (writes): Deletes the `properties` keyframes (location, rotation, scale; all without it) of pose bones `bones` at `frame`.
  - `bones` string or array, The bones; the selected ones when left out
  - `frame` number, The frame; the current frame when left out
  - `properties` string[], Whose keys to delete (all three when left out)

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

- `vertexGroup.unassign` (writes): Removes vertices (by index, else the selected ones) from vertex group `name`.

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

### Object > Constraints

- `constraint.add` (writes): Adds a constraint (track to, copy location, IK, limit, child of, …) with its settings to `object` or one of its bones.
  - `action` string, action: the action's name
  - `axes` boolean[], copyLocation and copyRotation: [x, y, z] axes copied
  - `axis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z` | `-x` | `-y` | `-z`, floor: the plane's side the owner stays on
  - `bone` string, A bone of the owner (an armature) to constrain instead of the object; the active bone in pose mode
  - `bulge` number, stretchTo and splineIk: how strongly the other axes thin as it stretches, 0 to 100 (1 keeps the volume)
  - `chain` integer, ik: bones in the chain counting this one, 0 runs to the root; splineIk: bones fitted to the curve (1)
  - `chainOffset` boolean, splineIk: keep the chain's root where it is
  - `channel` string, one of `locationX` | `locationY` | `locationZ` | `rotationX` | `rotationY` | `rotationZ` | `scaleX` | `scaleY` | `scaleZ`, action: the target's channel that picks the frame
  - `curveRadius` boolean, splineIk: the curve's radius scales the bones' thickness (true)
  - `evenDivisions` boolean, splineIk: share the curve evenly between the bones
  - `extrapolate` boolean, transform: map values beyond the source range too
  - `frameEnd` number, action: the frame the channel's maximum plays
  - `frameStart` number, action: the frame the channel's minimum plays
  - `fromMax` number[], transform: the source range's high end [x, y, z]
  - `fromMin` number[], transform: the source range's low end (degrees for rotation) [x, y, z]
  - `influence` number, How much of the result is used, 0 to 1 (1)
  - `invert` boolean[], copyLocation and copyRotation: [x, y, z] axes inverted
  - `iterations` integer, ik: solver iterations (500)
  - `keepAxis` string, one of `swingY` | `planeX` | `planeZ`, stretchTo: how Y turns to the target
  - `limit` boolean[], limitRotation: [x, y, z] angles limited
  - `mapFrom` string, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale`, transform: the target's channel read
  - `mapTo` string, one of `location` | `rotation` | `scale`, transform: the owner's channel set
  - `mapping` string[], transform: for the owner's x, y, z, the target axis each reads
  - `max` array or number, limitRotation: highest angles, degrees [x, y, z]; action: the channel value that plays frameEnd
  - `min` array or number, limitRotation: lowest angles, degrees [x, y, z]; action: the channel value that plays frameStart (degrees for rotation)
  - `mix` string, one of `add` | `replace` | `before` | `after` | `multiply` | `beforeFull` | `beforeSplit` | `afterFull` | `afterSplit`, transform: add or replace (location), add, replace, before, or after (rotation), replace or multiply (scale); action: how the action combines with the owner
  - `object` integer or string, The owner; the active object when left out
  - `offset` number, copyLocation: true adds to the owner's location; floor: metres beyond the plane
  - `ownerSpace` string, one of `world` | `local` | `pose` | `localWithParent`, copyLocation, copyRotation, transform: the space the owner is read in (pose and localWithParent on bones)
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `pole` integer or string, ik: the pole target object
  - `poleAngle` number, ik: degrees the chain turns from the pole
  - `poleBone` string, ik: a bone of the pole target
  - `preserveVolume` boolean, armature: blend the bones as dual quaternions
  - `rename` string, Its name
  - `restLength` number, stretchTo: the distance, in the owner's Y units, at which it does not stretch; 0 takes the distance now
  - `space` string, one of `world` | `local` | `pose` | `localWithParent`, limitRotation: the space the angles are read in (pose and localWithParent on bones)
  - `target` integer or string, The target object
  - `targetBone` string, A bone of the target (an armature) to use instead of the object
  - `targetSpace` string, one of `world` | `local` | `pose` | `localWithParent`, copyLocation, copyRotation, transform, action: the space the target is read in
  - `targets` object[], armature: the bones that move the owner, as { object, bone, weight }
  - `toMax` number[], transform: the destination range's high end [x, y, z]
  - `toMin` number[], transform: the destination range's low end (degrees for rotation) [x, y, z]
  - `trackAxis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z` | `-x` | `-y` | `-z`, trackTo and dampedTrack: the axis pointed at the target
  - `type` string, required, one of `trackTo` | `dampedTrack` | `copyLocation` | `copyRotation` | `limitRotation` | `childOf` | `ik` | `stretchTo` | `floor` | `transform` | `action` | `armature` | `splineIk`, The constraint (ik and splineIk on bones)
  - `upAxis` string, one of `x` | `y` | `z`, trackTo: the axis kept up
  - `useRotation` boolean, floor: the plane turns with the target
  - `volume` string, one of `xzx` | `x` | `z` | `none`, stretchTo: the axes that thin
  - `xzScale` string, one of `none` | `boneOriginal` | `inversePreserve` | `volumePreserve`, splineIk: the bones' thickness
  - `yScale` string, one of `none` | `fitCurve` | `boneOriginal`, splineIk: the bones' lengths

### Weights

- `paint.normalizeAll` (writes): Normalizes every vertex's weights to sum to 1, optionally keeping the active group.
  - `lockActive` boolean, Keep the paint group's weights and share the rest (true)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the painted or active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)

### Sculpt

- `sculpt.maskInvert` (writes): Inverts the sculpt mask. No parameters.
- `sculpt.maskClear` (writes): Clears the sculpt mask. No parameters.
- `sculpt.maskFill` (writes): Masks the whole mesh. No parameters.
- `sculpt.maskSmooth` (writes): Smooths the sculpt mask's edges. No parameters.
- `sculpt.detailFlood` (writes): Remeshes the whole mesh to the dynamic topology detail size. No parameters.
- `sculpt.faceSetsFromMask` (writes): Makes a face set from the masked faces. No parameters.
- `sculpt.faceSetsFromVisible` (writes): Makes a face set from the visible faces. No parameters.
- `sculpt.faceSetsFromLooseParts` (writes): Makes one face set per loose part of the mesh. No parameters.
- `sculpt.faceSetsClear` (writes): Removes every face set. No parameters.
- `sculpt.hideFaceSet` (writes): Hides the face set under the pointer. No parameters.
- `sculpt.isolateFaceSet` (writes): Shows only the face set under the pointer. No parameters.
- `sculpt.showAllFaces` (writes): Shows every hidden face again. No parameters.
- `sculpt.remesh` (writes): Remeshes `object` with voxels of `voxelSize`.
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the sculpted or active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `voxelSize` number, The size of the voxels the surface is rebuilt from, metres (0.1)

### Object > Particles

- `particles.add` (writes): Adds a particle system (Newtonian or airborne averaged boid emitter, or hair) with its settings to `object`.
  - `boids` object, Airborne boids. Enabled rules are averaged, not evaluated by priority. Up to 2048 particles, 1000 emission-plus-lifetime frames and 500000 particle-frames and 500000 birth/death-aware particle updates. Faces or vertices only; scene force fields and collisions are inert. Targets use current world-space positions.
  - `bounce` number, The share of speed kept on a bounce, 0 to 1 (0.5)
  - `childCount` integer, Hair: children per parent strand (10)
  - `childRadius` number, Hair: how far simple children spread round their parent, metres (0.2)
  - `children` string, one of `none` | `simple` | `interpolated`, Hair: child strands
  - `colliders` integer or string or array, Objects particles bounce off (ids or names; an empty list for none)
  - `count` integer, Particles or parent strands (1000, at most 100000)
  - `densityGroup` string, The vertex group whose weights set how densely particles and strands start (empty: everywhere alike)
  - `dieOnCollision` boolean, Particles die where they hit a collider
  - `distribution` string, one of `jittered` | `random`, How start points spread
  - `drag` number, Air drag: the share of speed lost per second
  - `dynamics` boolean or object, Hair: dynamics simulated in the physics bake (true: on with the defaults, false: off; an object: its settings, turning it on)
  - `emitFrom` string, one of `faces` | `verts` | `volume`, Where particles start
  - `frameEnd` number, Emitter: the last frame particles are born (200)
  - `frameStart` number, Emitter: the first frame particles are born (1)
  - `gravity` number, How strongly the scene's gravity pulls (1)
  - `hairLength` number, Hair: strand length, metres (4)
  - `instanceObject` integer or string, With renderAs object: the object copied at each particle (null for none)
  - `kind` string, one of `emitter` | `hair`, Emitter (particles that fly) or hair (strands)
  - `lifetime` number, Emitter: frames a particle lives (50)
  - `lifetimeRandom` number, Emitter: how much of the lifetime may randomly be cut, 0 to 1
  - `name` string, The system's name (ParticleSystem)
  - `normalVelocity` number, Start speed along the surface normal, m/s (1)
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the active one when left out
  - `objectVelocity` number[], Start velocity along the emitter's axes, m/s [x, y, z]
  - `physics` string, one of `newtonian` | `boids`, Emitter physics: Newtonian or airborne boids with averaged rules
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `randomVelocity` number, Start speed in a random direction, m/s
  - `renderAs` string, one of `halo` | `object` | `none`, How particles show
  - `rotationRandom` number, How far instances turn at random, 0 to 1
  - `seed` integer, Different seeds give different, each repeatable, particles (0)
  - `segments` integer, Hair: segments per strand (5)
  - `size` number, Particle size (halo diameter, instance scale), metres (0.05)
  - `sizeRandom` number, How much of the size may randomly be taken off, 0 to 1
  - `strandWidth` number, Hair: strand width at the root, metres (0.01)
  - `timestep` number, Seconds simulated per frame (0.04)
- `particles.remove` (writes): Removes particle system `system` from `object`.
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `system` integer or string, The system's index or name; the first when left out
- `particles.convert` (writes): Converts particle system `system` into a mesh object.
  - `object` integer or string, The mesh; the active one when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `system` integer or string, The system's index or name; the first when left out
- `particleEdit.reset` (writes): Deletes the grooming edits of the hair system. No parameters.

### Add > Curve

- `add.curveBezier` (writes): Adds a Bezier curve at `location` (with rotation, scale and `name`) and answers its name and object id; name it to address it in the same run.
  - `location` number[], Where to put it, in metres (the origin when left out) [x, y, z]
  - `name` string, The object's name
  - `radius` number, Size: the curve spans twice this (1)
  - `rotation` number[], Rotation in degrees, XYZ Euler [x, y, z]
  - `scale` number[], Scale [x, y, z]
- `add.curveCircle` (writes): Adds a Bezier circle curve at `location` (with rotation, scale and `name`) and answers its name and object id; name it to address it in the same run.
  - `location` number[], Where to put it, in metres (the origin when left out) [x, y, z]
  - `name` string, The object's name
  - `radius` number, Radius in metres (1)
  - `rotation` number[], Rotation in degrees, XYZ Euler [x, y, z]
  - `scale` number[], Scale [x, y, z]
- `add.curvePath` (writes): Adds a NURBS path curve at `location` (with rotation, scale and `name`) and answers its name and object id; name it to address it in the same run.
  - `location` number[], Where to put it, in metres (the origin when left out) [x, y, z]
  - `name` string, The object's name
  - `radius` number, Size: the path spans four times this (1)
  - `rotation` number[], Rotation in degrees, XYZ Euler [x, y, z]
  - `scale` number[], Scale [x, y, z]

### Curve

- `mode.shape` (reads): Toggles the active curve, text or lattice between object mode and its edit mode. No parameters.
- `curve.extrude` (writes): Extrudes new points from the selected curve end points by `offset`.
  - `offset` number[], Where the new point goes from the end point; continues the spline when left out [x, y, z]
- `curve.subdivide` (writes): Subdivides the segments between selected curve points. No parameters.
- `curve.toggleCyclic` (writes): Opens or closes the selected splines. No parameters.
- `curve.setHandleType` (writes): Sets the selected points' handle type (auto, vector, aligned, free).
  - `type` string, required, one of `auto` | `vector` | `aligned` | `free`, The handles' type
- `curve.deletePoints` (writes): Deletes the selected curve points. No parameters.

A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `text` string, required, What to type at the caret (or the end)
- `text.delete` (writes): Deletes `count` characters backward (or forward) from the caret in text edit mode.
  - `count` integer, How many (1)
  - `forward` boolean, Delete after the caret instead of before

### Object > Physics

- `physics.world.set` (writes): Sets the physics world: gravity, frame range, steps and iterations.
  - `frameEnd` integer, The last simulated frame
  - `frameStart` integer, The first simulated frame
  - `gravity` number[], Gravity in m/s² (default 0, 0, -9.81) [x, y, z]
  - `iterations` integer, Solver iterations per step (1 to 100)
  - `substeps` integer, Simulation steps per frame (1 to 100)
  - `timeScale` number, How fast simulated time runs (0.01 to 100)
- `physics.rigidBody.add` (writes): Makes `objects` (names or ids; the selection without it) rigid bodies (active or passive) with mass, shape, friction and damping.
  - `angularDamping` number, Angular damping, 0 to 1
  - `animated` boolean, A passive body moved by its animation, pushing active ones
  - `deactivateAngular` number, Below this spin (rad/s) the body may fall asleep
  - `deactivateLinear` number, Below this speed (m/s) the body may fall asleep
  - `deactivation` boolean, The body may fall asleep when it barely moves (and wakes when something hits it)
  - `enabled` boolean, Simulated (an active body that is not stays put)
  - `friction` number, Friction, 0 to 10
  - `linearDamping` number, Linear damping, 0 to 1
  - `margin` number, Collision margin in metres
  - `mass` number, Mass in kg
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `restitution` number, Bounciness, 0 to 1
  - `shape` string, one of `box` | `sphere` | `capsule` | `cylinder` | `convexHull` | `mesh`, The collision shape (mesh: passive bodies only)
  - `startDeactivated` boolean, The body starts asleep, hanging where it is until something hits it
  - `type` string, one of `active` | `passive`, Active bodies move; passive ones only collide

  - `flow` number, Things are carried along: they also slow by this share of their speed each second
  - `linearDrag` number, Drag: slowing in proportion to speed
  - `location` number[], Where to put it, in metres (the origin when left out) [x, y, z]
  - `maxDistance` number, Beyond this distance it does nothing (0 or less: no limit)
  - `minDistance` number, Within this distance it is at full strength (0 or less: none)
  - `name` string, The new empty's name
  - `quadraticDrag` number, Drag: slowing in proportion to speed squared
  - `rotation` number[], Rotation in degrees, XYZ Euler (wind and vortex act along its Z) [x, y, z]
  - `seed` integer, Turbulence: different seeds give different noise
  - `size` number, Turbulence: the size of its swirls in metres
  - `strength` number, How hard it pushes (m/s² on a particle at full strength; drag ignores it)
  - `type` string, one of `force` | `wind` | `vortex` | `turbulence` | `drag`, force: away from the origin (towards it when negative); wind: along the object's Z; vortex: round its Z; turbulence: noise; drag: slows things

- `physics.constraint.add` (writes): Adds a rigid body constraint (fixed, hinge, slider, spring, motor, …) between two objects. A motor independently drives translation and rotation on the constraint X axis.
  - `angleLimit` array, Hinge: [lower, upper] in degrees about Z, or null for none
  - `angularLimits` array, Generic spring: per axis X, Y, Z a [lower, upper] in degrees, or null for free
  - `angularMaxImpulse` number, Motor: maximum angular impulse control, 0 to 1000000000 (default 1); step impulse is value times seconds
  - `angularMotor` boolean, Motor: enable rotation about the constraint's X axis (default false)
  - `angularSprings` array, Generic spring: per axis X, Y, Z a stiffness in N·m/rad, or null for none
  - `angularTargetVelocity` number, Motor: body 1 relative to body 2 in rad/s, -100000 to 100000 (default 1)
  - `breakable` boolean, The constraint breaks when it must push harder than the threshold
  - `breakingThreshold` number, The impulse (N·s) in one step that breaks it
  - `disableCollisions` boolean, The joined bodies pass through each other (default true)
  - `distanceLimit` array, Slider: [lower, upper] in metres along X, or null for none
  - `enabled` boolean, The constraint acts
  - `linearLimits` array, Generic spring: per axis X, Y, Z a [lower, upper] in metres, or null for free
  - `linearMaxImpulse` number, Motor: maximum linear impulse control, 0 to 1000000000 (default 1); step impulse is value times seconds
  - `linearMotor` boolean, Motor: enable translation along the constraint's X axis (default false)
  - `linearSprings` array, Generic spring: per axis X, Y, Z a stiffness in N/m, or null for none
  - `linearTargetVelocity` number, Motor: body 1 relative to body 2 in m/s, -100000 to 100000 (default 1)
  - `object1` integer or string, The first rigid body joined
  - `object2` integer or string, The second rigid body joined
  - `objects` integer or string or array, The objects; the selection when left out
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `springDamping` number, Generic spring: the springs' damping
  - `type` string, one of `fixed` | `point` | `hinge` | `slider` | `genericSpring` | `motor`, fixed: one piece; point: a ball joint; hinge: turns about Z; slider: slides along X; genericSpring: per axis limits and springs; motor: drives along/about X

- `physics.bake` (reads): Bakes the physics simulation over the frame range; answers the cache state. Without anything simulated it fails. Nonfinite cloth/soft-body motion fails explicitly, discards the derived cache and stops automatic baking until Bake is requested again.
  - `wait` boolean, Bake every frame now (default); false starts a bake that physics.bakeStep runs
- `physics.bakeStep` (reads): Bakes `frames` more frames of the simulation and answers the cache state; divergent cloth/soft-body motion fails and stops automatic baking.
  - `frames` integer, Frames to bake now (default 4)
- `physics.free` (reads): Frees the baked physics cache and answers its state. No parameters.

### Geometry Nodes

- `nodes.newGroup` (writes): Creates a node group (geometry, shader, compositor) for a modifier, material, world or as a library group.
  - `material` integer or string, shader: the material (id or name) the group gives its surface (a Principled BSDF into the Material Output's Surface)
  - `modifier` integer, With object: the Geometry Nodes modifier (its index) to use the group instead of adding one
  - `name` string, The group's name (Geometry Nodes, Shader, or Volume when left out)
  - `object` integer or string, geometry: add a Geometry Nodes modifier using the group to this mesh object
  - `pick` number[], Instead of `object`/`objects`: a world point [x, y, z] in metres; the command acts on the object there now (the smallest whose mesh's bounds hold the point, else the nearest light, camera, empty, curve, text, lattice or armature whose origin is within 0.25 m). A place: with `basis`, a write by it is refused when what is at the point is no longer what was there (moved away, another moved in, its parent moved)
  - `tree` string, one of `geometry` | `shader`, geometry (the default): a Geometry Nodes group; shader: a material's surface and volume
  - `world` boolean, shader: the group is the world's volume (a Principled Volume into the Material Output's Volume)

## Examples

From [`agent/guide.md`](../agent/guide.md).

### Example 1: a table

The new scene has `Cube` (id 2) with material `Material`, `Light` and `Camera`.

```json
scene_run {"path": "scene.kscene", "steps": [
  {"command": "edit.delete", "params": {"objects": "Cube"}},
  {"command": "add.cube", "params": {"name": "Top", "location": [0, 0, 0.75], "scale": [1, 0.6, 0.04]}},
  {"command": "add.cylinder", "params": {"name": "Leg 1", "radius": 0.04, "depth": 0.72, "vertices": 16, "location": [0.9, 0.5, 0.36]}},
  {"command": "add.cylinder", "params": {"name": "Leg 2", "radius": 0.04, "depth": 0.72, "vertices": 16, "location": [-0.9, 0.5, 0.36]}},
  {"command": "add.cylinder", "params": {"name": "Leg 3", "radius": 0.04, "depth": 0.72, "vertices": 16, "location": [0.9, -0.5, 0.36]}},
  {"command": "add.cylinder", "params": {"name": "Leg 4", "radius": 0.04, "depth": 0.72, "vertices": 16, "location": [-0.9, -0.5, 0.36]}},
  {"command": "material.set", "params": {"material": "Material", "name": "Wood", "baseColor": "#8b5a2b", "roughness": 0.6}},
  {"command": "material.assign", "params": {"material": "Wood", "objects": ["Top", "Leg 1", "Leg 2", "Leg 3", "Leg 4"]}},
  {"command": "object.parent", "params": {"objects": ["Leg 1", "Leg 2", "Leg 3", "Leg 4"], "parent": "Top"}},
  {"command": "object.lookAt", "params": {"object": "Camera", "target": [0, 0, 0.5]}}
]}
scene_check {"path": "scene.kscene"}
```

All ten steps answer `"changed": true` (the cube's deletion answers `{"deleted": [2]}`), and the
check finds nothing wrong.

### Example 2: bring an object back into the shot

```json
scene_check {"path": "shot.kscene"}
```

It answers a note, `Cube is outside the camera's view, so renders will not show it`, with the fix
`{"command": "object.lookAt", "params": {"object": 4, "target": [0, 0, 200]}}` (4 is the camera's id).

```json
scene_run {"path": "shot.kscene", "steps": [
  {"command": "object.lookAt", "params": {"object": 4, "target": [0, 0, 200]}}
]}
scene_check {"path": "shot.kscene"}
```

The camera turns (the step answers its new `rotation`), and the check finds nothing wrong.

### Example 3: one material on three objects, and a key at 2 s

```json
scene_run {"path": "scene.kscene", "steps": [
  {"command": "material.new", "params": {"name": "Blue", "baseColor": "#2050ff", "assign": false}},
  {"command": "material.assign", "on": ["Cube", "Left", "Right"], "params": {"material": "Blue"}},
  {"command": "anim.insertKey", "at": {"time": 2}, "params": {"objects": "Right", "properties": ["location"]}}
]}
```

`material.assign` gives Blue to exactly the three objects `on` names, and `anim.insertKey` keys
Right's location at 2 s, frame 49 of a scene that starts at frame 1 at 24 fps (it answers
`"keys": 3`). The selection and the current frame are what they were before the run.

### Example 4: extrude a face without leaving edit mode behind

```json
scene_run {"path": "scene.kscene", "steps": [
  {"command": "mesh.extrude", "params": {"elements": {"object": "Left", "faces": [0]}, "distance": 0.5}}
]}
```

Left's face 0 moves out 0.5 m along its normal with four new side faces (`details.objects`'s
`mesh.faces` goes from 6 to 10), and the scene is still in object mode with nothing selected that
was not before. Without `elements`, the same run would be `mode.set {mode: "edit", object: "Left"}`,
`mesh.select {faces: [0]}`, `mesh.extrude {distance: 0.5}`, and edit mode would end with the run.
